					state ?= {
						owner ?= {
							OR = {
								this = scope:investor_country
								any_overlord_or_above = { this = scope:investor_country }
								any_scope_treaty = { binds = scope:investor_country  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = scope:investor_country } }
								any_overlord_or_above = { any_scope_treaty = { binds = scope:investor_country  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = scope:investor_country } } }
							}
						}
					}
				}
				}

					text = pmr_dam_nelson_winnipeg_surveyed_tt
